name: HiMill D1
notes: Official store price for Germany in EUR incl. duties/VAT (DDP; converted from USD 849, list USD 999; autumn sale until 30 Sep 2026). D1 vs D1S: 250 W brushed spindle with standard ER11 collet (D1S: brushless, quick tool change), anti-backlash lead screws (D1S: ball screws), 16 mm hardened shafts on X/Y/Z (D1S: linear rail on Z), ±0.04 mm accuracy and <0.02 mm runout (D1S: ±0.02 / <0.01 mm). Integrated automatic tool setter; 3D probe, 10 W laser and 4th axis (Ø50 × 159 mm) optional. Stepper motors, size not stated. Controlled via Maxmake's own MaxmakeLAB software/firmware.

accessories.name: 3D Probe
accessories.description: ±X/±Y/±Z touch probe (<0.01 mm repeatability) for auto zeroing, edge finding and surface mapping.

accessories.name: 10W Laser Module
accessories.description: 10 W 450 nm diode laser module that turns the HiMill D1/D1S into a laser engraver and cutter.

accessories.name: 4th Axis Module
accessories.description: 1:5 reduction rotary axis (up to Ø50 × 159 mm) for rotary and multi-sided machining on the D1/D1S.

accessories.name: Vacuum Platform Module
accessories.description: Vacuum table for holding thin sheet material; includes a basic starter air pump.

accessories.name: Flat-jaw Clamping Module
accessories.description: Flat-jaw vise that clamps stock from the side so the machining path stays clear.

accessories.name: Side Clamp Module (2pcs)
accessories.description: Pair of side clamps that hold stock from the side and free the full top surface.
